literal: Avoiding is necessary, fame-dimming actions, by those who say 'we will prosper'.
translation: Those who say, 'We will prosper,' must avoid doing actions that dim their fame.
modern: மேம்பாடு அடைவோம் என்று நினைப்பவர்கள், தங்களுடைய புகழைக் கெடுக்கும் செயல்களைச் செய்வதைத் தவிர்க்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the path of purity in action for those who aspire to rise in life. The word 'ஆஅதும்' refers to those who wish to grow, succeed, or prosper. The poet advises that such ambitious individuals must absolutely avoid ('ஓஒதல் வேண்டும்') any deed ('செய்வினை') that would diminish or ruin ('மாழ்கும்') their personal honor and fame ('ஒளி'). True prosperity cannot be built on actions that bring disgrace.
